description_en: Queries the databases of an instance
kebab_example: aliyun sddp list-data-sources --source-ip 192.0.2.1 --current-page 1 --page-size 20 --instance-id rm-2ze1abcdefgh0000 --product-id 5 --db-name business_db --connect-status Success --lang zh --max-results 20 --next-token token-example --data-source-id ds-example-001 --identify-status Enabled --data-asset-id asset-example-001 --product-code RDS --api-version 2026-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDataSources

parameters.help_en: The source IP address of the call
parameters.help_zh: 调用来源 IP 地址
parameters.name: source_ip

parameters.help_en: The current page number. Pages start from 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前查询页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Keep other filter conditions consistent when you query the next page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数。查询下一页时保持其他筛选条件一致
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The database instance identity. You can obtain the value from the Items[].InstanceId parameter in the response of the ListDataMaskingInstances operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据库实例标识，可从 ListDataMaskingInstances 的 Items[].InstanceId 获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The engine type. Valid values:
MySQL
MariaDB
Oracle
PostgreSQL
SQLServer
parameters.help_zh:
引擎类型，取值：
MySQL 。
MariaDB 。
Oracle 。
PostgreSQL 。
SQLServer
parameters.name: engine_type

parameters.help_en: The port for the database connection
parameters.name: port

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the cloud service type. 5: ApsaraDB RDS; 8: PolarDB; 27: PolarDB-X 2.0. If this parameter is specified together with ProductCode, the values must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品类型标识。5：RDS；8：POLARDB；27：PolarDBX2。与 ProductCode 同时指定时应对应
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en:
The connection status of the data source. Valid values:
UnConnected: Not connected.
Processing: Connecting.
Success: Connected.
Failed: Connection failed
parameters.help_zh: 数据源连接状态。UnConnected：未连接；Processing：连接处理中；Success：连接成功；Failed：连接失败
parameters.name: connect_status

parameters.help_en:
The language of the response message. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: A reserved pagination parameter. The ListDataSources operation uses CurrentPage and PageSize for pagination. Omit this parameter when you call the operation
parameters.help_zh: 保留的分页参数。当前 ListDataSources 使用 CurrentPage 和 PageSize 分页，调用时省略本参数
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: A reserved pagination cursor parameter. The ListDataSources operation uses CurrentPage and PageSize for pagination. Omit this parameter when you call the operation
parameters.help_zh: 保留的分页游标参数。当前 ListDataSources 使用 CurrentPage 和 PageSize 分页，调用时省略本参数
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the data source in Data Security Center. You can obtain the value from the Items[].DataSourceId parameter in the response of the ListDataSources operation
parameters.help_zh: 数据安全中心内的数据源标识，从 ListDataSources 的 Items[].DataSourceId 获取
parameters.name: data_source_id

parameters.help_en:
The status of the data source detection switch. Valid values:
Enable: Submitted for enabling.
Enabling: Enabling.
Enabled: Enabled.
EnableFailed: Enabling failed.
Disable: Submitted for disabling.
Disabling: Disabling.
Disabled: Disabled.
DisableFailed: Disabling failed
parameters.help_zh: 数据源识别开关状态。Enable：已提交开启；Enabling：开启中；Enabled：已开启；EnableFailed：开启失败；Disable：已提交关闭；Disabling：关闭中；Disabled：已关闭；DisableFailed：关闭失败
parameters.name: identify_status

parameters.help_en: The identifier of the data asset in Data Security Center
parameters.help_zh: 数据安全中心内的数据资产标识
parameters.name: data_asset_id

parameters.help_en: The code of the cloud service. Column encryption supports ApsaraDB RDS, PolarDB, and PolarDB-X 2.0. If this parameter is specified together with ProductId, the values must match
parameters.help_zh: 云产品编码。列加密支持 RDS、POLARDB、PolarDBX2；如同时传入 ProductId，二者必须对应
parameters.name: product_code

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned data

Items.description_en: The list of records returned by the query
Items.description_zh: 本次查询返回的记录列表

ConnectStatus.description_en:
The connection status of the data source. Valid values:
UnConnected: Not connected.
Processing: Connecting.
Success: Connected.
Failed: Connection failed
ConnectStatus.description_zh: 数据源连接状态。UnConnected：未连接；Processing：连接处理中；Success：连接成功；Failed：连接失败

DataAssetId.description_en: The identifier of the data asset in Data Security Center
DataAssetId.description_zh: 数据安全中心内的数据资产标识

DataSourceId.description_en: The identifier of the data source in Data Security Center
DataSourceId.description_zh: 数据安全中心内的数据源标识

DataSourceSize.description_en: The statistical value of the data source capacity. This field is not used in the column encryption process for relational databases
DataSourceSize.description_zh: 数据源容量统计值。关系型数据库的列加密流程不使用此字段

Description.description_en: The description of the data source

EngineType.description_en: The type of the database engine

ErrorCode.description_en: The business error code of the record or operation. This field can be empty if no error occurs. Evaluate this field together with ErrorMessage
ErrorCode.description_zh: 该记录或操作的业务错误码。无错误时可为空；应结合 ErrorMessage 判断

ErrorMessage.description_en: The business error message of the record or operation
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 该记录或操作的业务错误说明

IdentifyStatus.description_en:
The status of the data source detection switch. Valid values:
Enable: Submitted for enabling.
Enabling: Enabling.
Enabled: Enabled.
EnableFailed: Enabling failed.
Disable: Submitted for disabling.
Disabling: Disabling.
Disabled: Disabled.
DisableFailed: Disabling failed
IdentifyStatus.description_zh: 数据源识别开关状态。Enable：已提交开启；Enabling：开启中；Enabled：已开启；EnableFailed：开启失败；Disable：已提交关闭；Disabling：关闭中；Disabled：已关闭；DisableFailed：关闭失败

MemberAccount.description_en: The identity of the member accounts to which the asset belongs
MemberAccount.description_zh: 资产所属成员账号标识

Port.description_en: The port for the database connection

ProductCode.description_en: The code of the cloud service

ProductId.description_en: The identifier of the cloud service type. 5: ApsaraDB RDS; 8: PolarDB; 27: PolarDB-X 2.0

RegionId.description_en: The ID of the region where the asset resides

RegionName.description_en: The name of the region where the asset resides

ResourceGroupId.description_en: The ID of the resource group to which the asset belongs

TenantId.description_en: The identifier of the database tenant

UserName.description_en: The name of the database account used to connect to the data source
UserName.description_zh: 数据源连接使用的数据库账号名称

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of records that can be returned for the current cursor-based pagination
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次游标分页允许返回的最大记录数

NextToken.description_en: A compatible pagination cursor field. The ListDataSources operation uses page number-based pagination and does not rely on this field to determine whether more pages exist
NextToken.description_zh: 兼容的分页游标字段。当前 ListDataSources 使用页码分页，不依赖本字段判断是否还有下一页

PageSize.description_en: The number of records returned on each page
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The request identity, which is active when you invoke this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that meet the current statistics or query scope
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合当前统计或查询范围的总数量
